ms.report:
We are thrilled to announce the successful accomplishment of the milestone objectives as detailed in the project plan. Presented below is a thorough overview of our achievements, along with proof of milestone fulfillment:
・Oracle viability: Two documents as a result of the research conducted to determine the viability to implement Lendex protocol.
・Obtain possible data access points such as reservoir: One document provided, outlining the possible data access points of the protocols API, with a focus on: reliable pricing, protecting users, and usability of the proposed Lendex protocol API.
・Test standard EVM smart contract with oracle or centralized implementation for basic functionality: EVM smart contract and Cardano smart contract has been developed.
・Verify application to Cardano > EVM unlocking using Cardano Tx: A set of steps and scripts has been provided so users can interact with Lendex protocol covering use case when there is an EVM Borrower and a Cardano Lender.

Evidence: A link to the Github repository where all the documents, smart contracts and script tests are publicly available.
Acceptance Criteria:
・⁠Defined Oracle from EVM to use with corresponding justification supporting the decision: A research has been conducted with a document supporting it and we’ve decided to use Chainlink as the EVM Oracle provider.
・Data access point (API) defined for both EVM and Cardano: We've documented Lendex protocol flow and described an API to interact with user's wallets and the smart contracts to perform different actions such as: lock NFT, borrow NFT, pay debt, claim NFT back. Also we've described another API to retrieve info about NFTs been provided as collaterals
・Smart Contract for EVM running on Polygon testnet showcasing how the protocol is been used: We’ve developed the EVM Smart Contract showcasing how to interact with the protocol. However, is worth to mention the blockchain used was Ethereum Sepolia Testnet due to Polygon testnet discontinuation from Chai
